note: Type codes whose name on the page is written for a reader and therefore matches nothing on Wikidata. Each entry is tried BEFORE the page's own name, and the result still has to pass every guard — the item's label must be exactly this string, it must carry a first-flight date, and it must be a kind of aircraft. Kept deliberately tiny: a code belongs here only when the page's own label cannot match anything, which is why the reader-friendly compound names below are in it and nothing else is.
